verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop coding-agent app, so generating an app from a visual design is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions accepting sketches, images or PDFs as input, or turning a design into a working app. The documented features cover model choice, skills/MCP, git workflows and permissions, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design
